name: taxi-regulatory-platform
description: 出租车网约车合规监管系统

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:frontend: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; cd frontend && npx vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort --port ${FRONTEND_PORT:-43448}
scripts.start:frontend: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; cd frontend && nohup node server.js > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start: npm run start:backend && npm run start:frontend
